issue.body:
# ATTENTION

> [!NOTE]  
> YouTube changes their detection scripts regularly. That means that sometime you can face the detection message.
> If all the following instructions do not work, please **email filters@adguard.com** or wait until any update is available. 

> [!CAUTION] 
> Please do not use another adblocker in the same time because using another adblocker can delay/lags the YouTube loading (e.g., AdBlock Plus and AdBlock)[^1] OR interfere AdGuard's filtering functionality.

> [!CAUTION] 
> Please do not use an userscript related to the bypassing YouTube detection message like [TheRealJoelmatic/RemoveAdblockThing](https://github.com/TheRealJoelmatic/RemoveAdblockThing).
> Recently, YouTube anti-adblock script added infinite dummy advertisements to try to neutralize the userscript. ( [TheRealJoelmatic/RemoveAdblockThing#264](https://github.com/TheRealJoelmatic/RemoveAdblockThing/issues/264) )

> [!WARNING]
> Please check that there no another web browser extension that has adblocking feature is enabled on your web browser. It can interfere AdGuard's filtering functionality.

> [!IMPORTANT]  
> Saving memory feature of your web browser or sleep feature of your operating system can interfere AdGuard's filtering functionality.
> In this case, please re-enable AdGuard's filtering by toggling the protection toggle.
> Following the instructions can be needed.

### The instructions
1. Force to update the filters by clicking the reload button in AdGuard Browser Extension/AdGuard mobile or update tray menu in your system tray. [^2]
2. Reload the YouTube webpage without cache by pressing <kbd>Ctrl</kbd> + <kbd>Shift</kbd> + <kbd>R</kbd> [^3].
3. Clear cache, cookies and site data of your web browser.
4. Re-open your web browser completely (checking your system monitor[^4] will be better).

[^1]: https://gitlab.com/adblockinc/ext/adblockplus/adblockplusui/-/issues/1576
[^2]: [AdGuard for Windows](https://adguard.com/kb/adguard-for-windows/overview/#tray-menu); [AdGuard for Mac](https://adguard.com/kb/adguard-for-mac/overview/#updates-check); 
[^3]: On macOS, <kbd>Command</kbd> + <kbd>Shift</kbd> + <kbd>R</kbd>
[^4]: Task Manager on Windows, System Monitor on GNOME Shell, KDE System Guard on KDE Plasma or Activity Monitor on macOS. 


Previous issue https://github.com/AdguardTeam/AdguardFilters/issues/198973

issue.body:
# ATTENTION

> [!NOTE]  
> YouTube changes their detection scripts regularly. That means that sometime you can face the detection message.
> If all the following instructions do not work, please **email filters@adguard.com** or wait until any update is available. 

> [!CAUTION] 
> Please do not use another adblocker in the same time because using another adblocker can delay/lags the YouTube loading (e.g., AdBlock Plus and AdBlock)[^1] OR interfere AdGuard's filtering functionality.

> [!CAUTION] 
> Please do not use an userscript related to the bypassing YouTube detection message like [TheRealJoelmatic/RemoveAdblockThing](https://github.com/TheRealJoelmatic/RemoveAdblockThing).
> Recently, YouTube anti-adblock script added infinite dummy advertisements to try to neutralize the userscript. ( [TheRealJoelmatic/RemoveAdblockThing#264](https://github.com/TheRealJoelmatic/RemoveAdblockThing/issues/264) )

> [!WARNING]
> Please check that there no another web browser extension that has adblocking feature is enabled on your web browser. It can interfere AdGuard's filtering functionality.

> [!IMPORTANT]  
> Saving memory feature of your web browser or sleep feature of your operating system can interfere AdGuard's filtering functionality.
> In this case, please re-enable AdGuard's filtering by toggling the protection toggle.
> Following the instructions can be needed.

### The instructions
1. Force to update the filters by clicking the reload button in AdGuard Browser Extension/AdGuard mobile or update tray menu in your system tray. [^2]
2. Reload the YouTube webpage without cache by pressing <kbd>Ctrl</kbd> + <kbd>Shift</kbd> + <kbd>R</kbd> [^3].
3. Clear cache, cookies and site data of your web browser.
4. Re-open your web browser completely (checking your system monitor[^4] will be better).

[^1]: https://gitlab.com/adblockinc/ext/adblockplus/adblockplusui/-/issues/1576
[^2]: [AdGuard for Windows](https://adguard.com/kb/adguard-for-windows/overview/#tray-menu); [AdGuard for Mac](https://adguard.com/kb/adguard-for-mac/overview/#updates-check); 
[^3]: On macOS, <kbd>Command</kbd> + <kbd>Shift</kbd> + <kbd>R</kbd>
[^4]: Task Manager on Windows, System Monitor on GNOME Shell, KDE System Guard on KDE Plasma or Activity Monitor on macOS. 


Previous issue https://github.com/AdguardTeam/AdguardFilters/issues/198973

Please block Ad-Shield advertisement by installing [tinyShield userscript](https://github.com/FilteringDev/tinyShield).
Please check its installation guideline written in English by visiting [this URL](https://github.com/FilteringDev/tinyShield/blob/main/README.md).

If you can understand Korean language, please refer https://github.com/FilteringDev/tinyShield/blob/main/README.ko.md.

New change of tinyShield's build script for Apple Safari Extension user (made at 2026 Apr 21) is available.

## Still Have a Problem?
An issue is occurred when the userscript is applied, please report to [this issue tracker](https://github.com/FilteringDev/tinyShield/issues).

### Issue URL (Incorrect Blocking) [https://kakaku.com/item/K0000935097/](https://adguardteam.github.io/AnonymousRedirect/redirect.html?url=https%3A%2F%2Fkakaku.com%2Fitem%2FK0000935097%2F) ### Comment > False positive / site breakage: trj.valuecommerce.com blocks navigation to Nojima Online > > When using AdGuard Public DNS (94.140.14.14), trj.valuecommerce.com is resolved to 0.0.0.0 / ::. > This causes a site breakage on Nojima Online (a Japanese e-commerce website). > When a user visits Nojima Online through an affiliate link from Kakaku.com, the navigation flow reaches the following page successfully: > https://online.nojima.co.jp/contents/vc/cushion.html > This page loads the following JavaScript: > https://trj.valuecommerce.com/vcushion.js > With AdGuard Public DNS enabled, this request fails in Chrome with: > net::ERR_ADDRESS_INVALID > As a result, the JavaScript required for the redirect cannot be loaded, the browser displays a blank page, and the user cannot proceed to the intended Nojima Online product page. > DNS test: > AdGuard Public DNS (94.140.14.14): > trj.valuecommerce.com -> 0.0.0.0 / :: > Google Public DNS (8.8.8.8): > trj.valuecommerce.com -> daxym8vtpycty.cloudfront.net -> valid IP addresses > Disabling AdGuard DNS resolves the issue and the user can navigate to the product page normally. > Although trj.valuecommerce.com is used as part of affiliate tracking, blocking this domain also breaks the user's navigation to the merchant website. > Could you please review this blocking rule and consider adding an exception so that the navigation flow is not broken? ``` Username: @kmabashi ``` ### Screenshots

### Issue URL (Incorrect Blocking)
[https://www.lalesbienne.com/](https://adguardteam.github.io/AnonymousRedirect/redirect.html?url=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.lalesbienne.com%2F)

### Comment
> AdGuard's site report (reports.adguard.com/en/lalesbienne.com/report.html) lists lalesbienne.com in the category "Adult", so it is blocked by AdGuard DNS Family Protection. This is a false positive. Screenshot 1 shows the "Adult" category; screenshot 2 shows the site's About page.
> 
> Hello,
> 
> I'm writing on behalf of La Lesbienne (https://www.lalesbienne.com), an independent editorial journal documenting lesbian history, politics and culture. We publish long-form essays, reporting, book reviews, literary criticism and archival research, and we are currently applying for non-profit status in Estonia.
> 
> Visitors on filtered networks are being blocked from reaching the site. We believe the domain is uncategorized or has been automatically miscategorized, most likely because of the word "lesbienne" (French for "lesbian") in the domain name and because the site is new.
> 
> The site contains no sexually explicit, pornographic or adult material. It is an editorial publication comparable to a literary or current-affairs magazine. Several filtering vendors have already reviewed it and categorized it accordingly: Forcepoint and OpenText BrightCloud as News and Media, and Symantec as Society/Daily Living.
> 
> We request that lalesbienne.com and www.lalesbienne.com be categorized as News & Media (secondary: Arts & Culture or Education), and that any adult, mature, sexuality-related or uncategorized/new-domain classification be removed. Our editorial scope is described at https://www.lalesbienne.com/about.
> 
> Thank you for your review.
> 
> Kay
> Business Manager, La Lesbienne
> `kay@lalesbienne.com`

> 
> Visitors on filtered networks are being blocked from reaching the site. We believe the domain is uncategorized or has been automatically miscategorized, most likely because of the word "lesbienne" (French for "lesbian") in the domain name and because the site is new.
> 
> The site contains no sexually explicit, pornographic or adult material. It is an editorial publication comparable to a literary or current-affairs magazine. ### Issue URL (Incorrect Blocking)
[https://meijer.com/](https://adguardteam.github.io/AnonymousRedirect/redirect.html?url=https%3A%2F%2Fmeijer.com%2F)

### Comment
> Problem just started today.
> 
> (First two snaps) Sometimes I get the web page with all those broken image links, sometimes I get the "Access Denied" page.
> 
> To get the page to display properly (third snap), I have to switch to Cloud-flare or Google DNS. Problem happens EVEN when I use your UNFILTERED servers!
> 
> Problem occurs with Edge, Chrome, and Firefox (snaps are from Edge), and both plain DNS or DNS-over-HTTP.
> 
> I snagged the url for one of the broken image links -

issue.body:
# ATTENTION

> [!NOTE]  
> YouTube changes their detection scripts regularly. That means that sometime you can face the detection message.
> If all the following instructions do not work, please **email filters@adguard.com** or wait until any update is available. 

> [!CAUTION] 
> Please do not use another adblocker in the same time because using another adblocker can delay/lags the YouTube loading (e.g., AdBlock Plus and AdBlock)[^1] OR interfere AdGuard's filtering functionality.

> [!CAUTION] 
> Please do not use an userscript related to the bypassing YouTube detection message like [TheRealJoelmatic/RemoveAdblockThing](https://github.com/TheRealJoelmatic/RemoveAdblockThing).
> Recently, YouTube anti-adblock script added infinite dummy advertisements to try to neutralize the userscript. ( [TheRealJoelmatic/RemoveAdblockThing#264](https://github.com/TheRealJoelmatic/RemoveAdblockThing/issues/264) )

> [!WARNING]
> Please check that there no another web browser extension that has adblocking feature is enabled on your web browser. It can interfere AdGuard's filtering functionality.

> [!IMPORTANT]  
> Saving memory feature of your web browser or sleep feature of your operating system can interfere AdGuard's filtering functionality.
> In this case, please re-enable AdGuard's filtering by toggling the protection toggle.
> Following the instructions can be needed.

### The instructions
1. Force to update the filters by clicking the reload button in AdGuard Browser Extension/AdGuard mobile or update tray menu in your system tray. [^2]
2. Reload the YouTube webpage without cache by pressing <kbd>Ctrl</kbd> + <kbd>Shift</kbd> + <kbd>R</kbd> [^3].
3. Clear cache, cookies and site data of your web browser.
4. Re-open your web browser completely (checking your system monitor[^4] will be better).

[^1]: https://gitlab.com/adblockinc/ext/adblockplus/adblockplusui/-/issues/1576
[^2]: [AdGuard for Windows](https://adguard.com/kb/adguard-for-windows/overview/#tray-menu); [AdGuard for Mac](https://adguard.com/kb/adguard-for-mac/overview/#updates-check); 
[^3]: On macOS, <kbd>Command</kbd> + <kbd>Shift</kbd> + <kbd>R</kbd>
[^4]: Task Manager on Windows, System Monitor on GNOME Shell, KDE System Guard on KDE Plasma or Activity Monitor on macOS. 


Previous issue https://github.com/AdguardTeam/AdguardFilters/issues/198973

# Sorry. The website is infected by AdShield, Inc.

Unfortunately, It is complicated to resolve with a regular adblock rule because the website is being protected by service of Ad-Shield that is an anti-adblock company.

## Userscript Installation
Please block Ad-Shield advertisement by installing [tinyShield userscript](https://github.com/FilteringDev/tinyShield).
Please check its installation guideline written in English by visiting [this URL](https://github.com/FilteringDev/tinyShield/blob/main/README.md).

If you can understand Korean language, please refer https://github.com/FilteringDev/tinyShield/blob/main/README.ko.md.

New change of tinyShield's build script for Apple Safari Extension user (made at 2026 Apr 21) is available.

## Still Have a Problem?
An issue is occurred when the userscript is applied, please report to [this issue tracker](https://github.com/FilteringDev/tinyShield/issues).

Your comment When I left-click "Chat Support" at the bottom right (screenshot 1) of the Mizuho Bank homepage ( `https://www.mizuhobank.co.jp/index.html` ), the window (screenshot 2) does not appear. Upon investigation, I found that adding the following to "My filters" allows the chat support window to display correctly: `@@||googletagmanager.com/gtm.js$domain=mizuhobank.co.jp` I have created a pull request and am submitting it now. 2. ### Issue URL (Incorrect Blocking)
[https://www.lalesbienne.com/](https://adguardteam.github.io/AnonymousRedirect/redirect.html?url=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.lalesbienne.com%2F)

### Comment
> AdGuard's site report (reports.adguard.com/en/lalesbienne.com/report.html) lists lalesbienne.com in the category "Adult", so it is blocked by AdGuard DNS Family Protection. This is a false positive. Screenshot 1 shows the "Adult" category; screenshot 2 shows the site's About page.
> 
> Hello,
> 
> I'm writing on behalf of La Lesbienne (https://www.lalesbienne.com), an independent editorial journal documenting lesbian history, politics and culture. We publish long-form essays, reporting, book reviews, literary criticism and archival research, and we are currently applying for non-profit status in Estonia.
> 
> Visitors on filtered networks are being blocked from reaching the site. We believe the domain is uncategorized or has been automatically miscategorized, most likely because of the word "lesbienne" (French for "lesbian") in the domain name and because the site is new.
> 
> The site contains no sexually explicit, pornographic or adult material. It is an editorial publication comparable to a literary or current-affairs magazine. Several filtering vendors have already reviewed it and categorized it accordingly: Forcepoint and OpenText BrightCloud as News and Media, and Symantec as Society/Daily Living.
> 
> We request that lalesbienne.com and www.lalesbienne.com be categorized as News & Media (secondary: Arts & Culture or Education), and that any adult, mature, sexuality-related or uncategorized/new-domain classification be removed. Our editorial scope is described at https://www.lalesbienne.com/about.
> 
> Thank you for your review.
> 
> Kay
> Business Manager, La Lesbienne
> `kay@lalesbienne.com`

issue.title: www.lalesbienne.com

labels.name: T: Incorrect Blocking
labels.description: Website or app not working properly due to filtering

labels.name: A: In progress
labels.description: Work on the issue is in progress

issue.body:
### Issue URL (Incorrect Blocking)
[https://www.lalesbienne.com/](https://adguardteam.github.io/AnonymousRedirect/redirect.html?url=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.lalesbienne.com%2F)

### Comment
> AdGuard's site report (reports.adguard.com/en/lalesbienne.com/report.html) lists lalesbienne.com in the category "Adult", so it is blocked by AdGuard DNS Family Protection. This is a false positive. Screenshot 1 shows the "Adult" category; screenshot 2 shows the site's About page.
> 
> Hello,
> 
> I'm writing on behalf of La Lesbienne (https://www.lalesbienne.com), an independent editorial journal documenting lesbian history, politics and culture. We publish long-form essays, reporting, book reviews, literary criticism and archival research, and we are currently applying for non-profit status in Estonia.
> 
> Visitors on filtered networks are being blocked from reaching the site. We believe the domain is uncategorized or has been automatically miscategorized, most likely because of the word "lesbienne" (French for "lesbian") in the domain name and because the site is new.
> 
> The site contains no sexually explicit, pornographic or adult material. It is an editorial publication comparable to a literary or current-affairs magazine. Several filtering vendors have already reviewed it and categorized it accordingly: Forcepoint and OpenText BrightCloud as News and Media, and Symantec as Society/Daily Living.
> 
> We request that lalesbienne.com and www.lalesbienne.com be categorized as News & Media (secondary: Arts & Culture or Education), and that any adult, mature, sexuality-related or uncategorized/new-domain classification be removed. Our editorial scope is described at https://www.lalesbienne.com/about.
> 
> Thank you for your review.
> 
> Kay
> Business Manager, La Lesbienne
> `kay@lalesbienne.com`



### Screenshots
<details>
  <summary>Screenshot 1</summary>

  ![Screenshot 1](https://cdn.adguardcdn.com/sitereports/orzi424y1r4k4w44kw4w0koogwcwggoavh4rmzrqqw.jpg?nc=1)
</details>

<details>
  <summary>Screenshot 1 with AdGuard disabled</summary>

  ![Screenshot 1](https://cdn.adguardcdn.com/sitereports/ni359rmt3ms0c0owgwookgckws84840o2xdtby2myo.jpg?nc=1)
</details>

### System configuration

| Information | Value |
|-------------|-------|
AdGuard product: | AdGuard DNS
DNS setup: | Other
DNS server: | Family protection
Browser: | Chrome

issue.body:
# Sorry. The website is infected by AdShield, Inc.

Unfortunately, It is complicated to resolve with a regular adblock rule because the website is being protected by service of Ad-Shield that is an anti-adblock company.

## Userscript Installation
Please block Ad-Shield advertisement by installing [tinyShield userscript](https://github.com/FilteringDev/tinyShield).
Please check its installation guideline written in English by visiting [this URL](https://github.com/FilteringDev/tinyShield/blob/main/README.md).

If you can understand Korean language, please refer https://github.com/FilteringDev/tinyShield/blob/main/README.ko.md.

New change of tinyShield's build script for Apple Safari Extension user (made at 2026 Apr 21) is available.

## Still Have a Problem?
An issue is occurred when the userscript is applied, please report to [this issue tracker](https://github.com/FilteringDev/tinyShield/issues).

### Prerequisites

- [x] This site DOES NOT contain sexually explicit material, otherwise use [NSFW-specific form](./new?template=bug_report_NSFW.yml);
- [x] Filters were updated before reproducing an issue;
- [x] AdGuard product version is up-to-date;

- [x] If the site or app is broken, disabling AdGuard protection resolves an issue.

### What product do you use?

AdGuard for Android, AdGuard for iOS

### AdGuard version

*

### What type of problem have you encountered?

Missed analytics or tracker

### Which browser(s) do you use?

the problem is with app, not a site

### Which device do you use?

Mobile

### Where is the problem encountered?

facebook for ios and android

### Ad Blocking

AdGuard Base filter

### Privacy

_No response_

### Social Widgets

_No response_

### Annoyances

_No response_

### Security

_No response_

### Other

_No response_

### DNS filters

_No response_

### Language-specific

_No response_

### What Stealth Mode options do you have enabled?

_No response_

### Add your comment and screenshots

Facebook/Meta appears to be generating an increasingly large number of `sonar` related `fbcdn.net` hostnames.

A collected set currently contains more than **7,000 individual Sonar hostnames**. please see the list here:

https://pastebin.com/TUPCjEG9


 Rather than being random one-off hosts, they follow several highly consistent naming families distributed across Meta's CDN locations.

The main observed patterns include:


sonar.<location>.fna.fbcdn.net
sonar6.<location>.fna.fbcdn.net

sonar-<location>.xx.fbcdn.net
sonar6-<location>.xx.fbcdn.net

edge-sonar-mini-shv-<node>-<location>.fbcdn.net
edge-sonar-mini6-shv-<node>-<location>.fbcdn.net


Examples:


sonar.faae1-1.fna.fbcdn.net
sonar6.faae1-1.fna.fbcdn.net

sonar-iad3-1.xx.fbcdn.net
sonar6-iad3-1.xx.fbcdn.net

edge-sonar-mini-shv-01-atl3.fbcdn.net
edge-sonar-mini6-shv-01-jnb2.fbcdn.net


There is direct evidence from Meta's own `facebook/dns` repository that these domains belong to a dedicated **Sonar** system rather than simply being ordinary static CDN hostnames.

Meta's DNS code contains an `isSonar()` function which identifies a hostname as Sonar when it:

1. ends in `.fbcdn.net`, and
2. contains `sonar` in the hostname.

It also separately recognizes WhatsApp's `.snr.whatsapp.net` Sonar-style domains.

Source:

https://github.com/facebook/dns/blob/9875b2096cd794d436e2af59609d61d5a61db371/dnsrocks/logger/utils.go

Meta's DNS logger also treats Sonar queries differently from ordinary DNS requests. The code explicitly states:

> We only sample non-sonar names

The relevant condition is:

```go
if localRand.Float64() > l.samplingRate && !isSonar(state) {
    return
}
```

This means requests classified as Sonar bypass the normal sampling exclusion applied to non-Sonar names and continue through the DNS logging path.

The logger records information including the query address, response address, query time, and DNS query message.

Source:

https://github.com/facebook/dns/blob/9875b2096cd794d436e2af59609d61d5a61db371/dnsrocks/logger/dnstap_logger.go

Meta's own tests also contain explicit Sonar hostname examples such as:

```text
f41366ce340-kdywlzry1535569283-sonar.xy.fbcdn.net
f41366ce340-kdywlzry1535569283-sonar.snr.fbcdn.net
f3d77e02580klz54ggi-uavvfioa1427990455-sonar.snr.fbcdn.net
fd45417ba30KDACNUXI-fgeytrfl1427990452-sonar.2914.fna.fbcdn.net
```

This confirms that these randomized-looking `*-sonar.*.fbcdn.net` hostnames are deliberately recognized as part of Meta's Sonar infrastructure.

Source:

https://github.com/facebook/dns/blob/9875b2096cd794d436e2af59609d61d5a61db371/dnsrocks/logger/dnstap_logger_test.go

Based on the available evidence, these hosts appear to be associated with **network telemetry, measurement, or diagnostics** rather than ordinary Facebook/Instagram image and video CDN delivery.

The scale is becoming difficult to handle using individual hostname rules. Thousands of location-specific Sonar hosts already exist, and additional CDN locations or node variants can generate more hostnames while retaining the same basic naming structure.

For that reason, I think it would make more sense to block the Sonar hostname family using a generic filtering rule

Conceptually:


suggested filter: * sonar * .fbcdn.net^


Interestingly, this is also very close to Meta's own internal detection logic, which considers an `.fbcdn.net` hostname containing `sonar` to be a Sonar domain.

A generic rule would target the dedicated Sonar infrastructure while avoiding a broad block of `fbcdn.net`, which could interfere with legitimate Facebook and Instagram CDN traffic.

I think these domains are strong candidates for classification as **Facebook/Meta telemetry or network-measurement endpoints** and for inclusion in the **AdGuard DNS filter**.


### Privacy

- [x] I agree to follow this condition

issue.body:
# Sorry. The website is infected by AdShield, Inc.

Unfortunately, It is complicated to resolve with a regular adblock rule because the website is being protected by service of Ad-Shield that is an anti-adblock company.

## Userscript Installation
Please block Ad-Shield advertisement by installing [tinyShield userscript](https://github.com/FilteringDev/tinyShield).
Please check its installation guideline written in English by visiting [this URL](https://github.com/FilteringDev/tinyShield/blob/main/README.md).

If you can understand Korean language, please refer https://github.com/FilteringDev/tinyShield/blob/main/README.ko.md.

New change of tinyShield's build script for Apple Safari Extension user (made at 2026 Apr 21) is available.

## Still Have a Problem?
An issue is occurred when the userscript is applied, please report to [this issue tracker](https://github.com/FilteringDev/tinyShield/issues).
